spell_cards.Name: Illuminate
spell_cards.Description:
Reveals the entire Battlefield, the enemy's Resources and the enemy's Population for 10 seconds.
Provides a speed boost to Magic Units for 15 seconds.

spell_cards.Name: Miner Hustle
spell_cards.Description: Boosts Miners' speed by 50% for 10 seconds.

spell_cards.Name: Rage
spell_cards.Description: Boosts Light Units' attack and movement speed by 25% for 5 seconds.

spell_cards.Name: Summoners Toll
spell_cards.Description:
When active, if an enemy casts a spell, 1 Spearton Dead spawns against them.
Spawns an additional Spearton Dead. (Requires Temple I)

spell_cards.Name: Surge
spell_cards.Description: Improves Elemental effects duration by 50% and damage frequency by 50% for 10 seconds.

spell_cards.Name: Tesla Coil
spell_cards.Description: Transforms a captured Center Tower into a powerful electric tower that discharges electricity.

spell_cards.Name: Healing Ward
spell_cards.Description: Cure and Heal friendly Units within the spell's range; lasts for 15 seconds.

spell_cards.Name: Acid Rain
spell_cards.Description:
Conjures Acid Rain to fall from the sky, poisoning non-Toxic Units. Deads gain speed bonus when in the rain.
Acid Rain does not cover either base.

spell_cards.Name: Double Edged
spell_cards.Description:
Spawns Spirit Speartons for each player that automatically attack.
Each player spawns 2 Spirit Speartons from their own side that automatically attack. (Requires Temple I)

spell_cards.Name: Heavy Healing Wisp
spell_cards.Description: Creates a wisp that Heals one Heavy Unit at a time for 25 Health per second; lasts for 10 seconds.

spell_cards.Name: Lightning Storm
spell_cards.Description: Creates a thunderstorm, causing a slow moving storm cloud to strike lightning on enemies.

spell_cards.Name: Projectile Barrier
spell_cards.Description: Conjures Ã  protective shield around your army's front lines that blocks all projectiles for 12 seconds.

spell_cards.Name: Snow Squall
spell_cards.Description: Creates a snow squall that slows affected Units; lasts for 15 seconds.

spell_cards.Name: Scorch
spell_cards.Description: Every 5 seconds add 1 second to the duration. Calls down a hail of comets that land over 2 seconds. Targets hit will be knocked down and take a medium amount of damage and receive burn damage. Maxes out at 50 seconds. 10 stacks will produce 10x comets.
